scope: Read-only ABC-130K LeRobot train T-shirt task storage estimate; no video payload downloaded or decoded; not a visual quality audit
method: Bounded HTTP Range requests read MP4 atom headers and moov sample tables only; sum stsz video sample bytes by stts/ctts timestamps within source episode interval. Per-request timeout 20 s, exact206 validation, no long retries.

download_cache.interpretation: Source MP4 shards contain multiple episodes/tasks. Whole-shard downloads/cache can exceed final task-only bytes by several-fold; this sample uses 3.279 GB of source shards for 0.341 GB of selected episode payload. This ratio is not a guarantee for a 10h selection because shard reuse matters.

workspace_budget.note: The initial 80–120GB allowance is superseded by exact final-candidate source-path metadata: source cache train106.64GB; train+dev116.99GB; train+dev+reserve137.16GB. Reserve 200GB free workspace for the all-three source cache + ~20GB compressed derivative + temporary files/headroom; weights/checkpoints excluded.

annotation.preferred: Window manifests referencing episode ID + source timestamps; keep no permanent duplicated clips by default. Annotation JSON/JSONL is negligible next to video. If saving overlapping clips, account for measured clip durations and overlap independently.

raw_native_mcap.conclusion: Do not substitute this LeRobot estimate for high-resolution native MCAP. Cameras, resolution, compression and extra streams differ; exact T-shirt native size requires a native file manifest.

limitations: 9 metadata samples covering about 30min; not random/stratified by all visual conditions.
No pixel/video payload was inspected; cannot conclude task identity/visual quality from sample tables.
MP4 container and Parquet metadata overhead not directly measured; included conservatively in 15GB net planning allowance.
No raw native MCAP files were probed.
